 In The High Court Of Uttarakhand
 At Nainital
 (Before the National Lok Adalat)
 The Hon'Ble Sri Justice Alok Kumar Verma
 11Th May, 2024
 Criminal Miscellaneous Application No.2493 Of 2023
Mohd. Akram and three Others .....Applicants
 Versus
State of Uttarakhand and Another .....Respondents
Counsel for the Applicants : Mr. Mohd. Azim, Advocate.

High Court Of Uttarakhand
 At Nainital

sentences.text:
Counsel for the State : Ms. Meenakshi Sharma,
 Brief Holder.

Counsel for the Respondent : Mr. Mohd. Umar,
No.2 Advocate.
Hon'ble Alok Kumar Verma, J.

The present Application under Section 482 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 has been filed to
quash the entire proceedings of Criminal Case No.1653 of 2020, "State vs. Naseem and Others",
pending before the Court of Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Khatima, District Udham Singh
Nagar under Sections 498A, 323, 506 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860, Section 3 and Section 4 of the
Dowry Prohibition Act, 1961.

2. The applicant no.1 is the father-in-law, applicant no.2 is the mother-in-law, applicant no.3 is the
brother-in- law and applicant no.4 is the sister-in-law of the respondent no.2.

3.
All the applicants are present in-person.
They are identified by Mr. Mohd. Azim, Advocate.
Respondent no.2 - Smt. Afsana is present in-person.
She is identified by Mr. Mohd. Umar, Advocate.
4. Both the parties have submitted that a Compounding Application and affidavits, filed by the parties, are on record.
A Compromise Application has been filed by the parties today before the National Lok Adalat.
5. Both, the applicants and the respondent no.2 submitted that there were matrimonial disputes between them and they have resolved their disputes.
They have requested to quash the entire proceedings of said Criminal Case.
6. Learned counsel for the State has submitted that there were matrimonial disputes between the parties and they have resolved their disputes.
Therefore, the State has no objection to the Compounding Application.
7. The Compromise Application is verified.

8. Keeping in view the totality of the facts and circumstances of the case, this Court is of the view that ends of justice would be met, if the entire proceedings of Criminal Case No.1653 of 2020, "State vs. Naseem and Others", pending before the Court of Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Khatima,
District Udham Singh Nagar are quashed.
